name: Ukor's Burden
summary: At the Valley of Trials, Ukor’s rejected provisions leave him needing help to carry them back to Razor Hill.

sections.title: A Well-Intentioned Mistake
sections.body:
Ukor, an orc peon, rarely acts on his own. Yet he carried provisions from the inn in Razor Hill to feed young recruits in the Valley of Trials. The journey took him through Durotar’s red dust and dangerous wildlife.

The overseers and instructors refused the food, believing hardship and hunger make true warriors. Now Ukor waits outside the canyon’s mouth, afraid of the beasts on the trail back. He has entrusted the sack to passing travelers and asks them to return it to Innkeeper Grosk.

faq.answer: Ukor’s Burden holds food and supplies from the Razor Hill inn. Ukor hoped to feed the young orcs and trolls in training, but the Valley of Trials refuses outside provisions.

faq.q: Why did the Valley of Trials reject the food?
aliases: why valley of trials refused food
why didnt they want the food
faq.answer: The overseers in the Valley of Trials believe hardship and hunger build character in young warriors. Innkeeper Grosk says hunger gives recruits spirit, so they refuse outside charity.

faq.q: Where does the burden need to go?
aliases: where do i take ukors burden
faq.answer: Take the sack back to Innkeeper Grosk at the inn in Razor Hill. He will put the provisions back on the shelves and offer a drink to whoever brings them home.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you see how Durotar’s harsh trials shape new soldiers. Even a kind offer must yield to the demands of their training.
